question: What will be the amount due on ₹12,000 in 2 years when the rate of simple interest on successive years is 9% and 10%, respectively?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹12,000

Time (t) = 2 years

Rate for 1st year (r₁) = 9%

Rate for 2ⁿd year (r₂) = 10%

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = dfrac{P times r times t}{100}

Amount (A) = P + SI

**Calculations:**

SI for 1st year = dfrac{12000 times 9 times 1}{100}

⇒ SI₁ = ₹1,080

SI for 2ⁿd year = dfrac{12000 times 10 times 1}{100}

⇒ SI₂ = ₹1,200

Total SI = SI₁ + SI₂

⇒ Total SI = ₹1,080 + ₹1,200

⇒ Total SI = ₹2,280

Amount (A) = P + Total SI

⇒ A = ₹12,000 + ₹2,280

⇒ A = ₹14,280

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
